item.title: Lebanon aims for state control over all weaponry
item.description: The President of Lebanon has responded to inquiries from US Senator Marco Rubio regarding the status of Hezbollah's arsenal. The leader stated that the nation is dedicated to ensuring the government maintains exclusive authority over all arms.

item.title: মক্কায় মসজিদে অনৈতিকতার দায়ে দুই বাংলাদেশির মৃত্যুদণ্ড কার্যকর
item.description: সৌদি আরবের মক্কায় একটি মসজিদে অনৈতিক আচরণের অভিযোগে এক বাংলাদেশি নারী ও পুরুষের মৃত্যুদণ্ড কার্যকর করা হয়েছে। বিচারকের স্বেচ্ছাধীন ক্ষমতা বা ‘তাআজির’ বিধানের আওতায় আদালত এই দণ্ডাদেশ প্রদান করেন।

item.title: পাকিস্তানের সামরিক নেতৃত্বের চ্যালেঞ্জ ও রাজনৈতিক প্রেক্ষাপট
item.description: ইমরান খানের নেতৃত্বাধীন দল ২০১৮ সালের নির্বাচনে পাঞ্জাব ও খাইবার পাখতুনখাওয়ায় জয়ী হয়ে কেন্দ্রীয় সরকার গঠন করেছিল। বর্তমান পরিস্থিতিতে দেশটির সামরিক বাহিনীর জন্য রাজনৈতিক পথ মসৃণ নয় বলে মনে করা হচ্ছে।

item.title: Olympic runner Beth Dobbin bedbound due to chronic illness
item.description: Former British sprinter Beth Dobbin, who competed in the 2021 Tokyo Olympics, is now mostly confined to bed. She was diagnosed with ME, a severe condition for which no medical cure currently exists.

item.title: রোনালদোর জাতীয় দলে ফেরা নিয়ে তাঁর বোনের সংশয় প্রকাশ
item.description: পর্তুগাল জাতীয় দলে ক্রিস্টিয়ানো রোনালদোর পুনরায় যোগ দেওয়া নিয়ে অনিশ্চয়তা দেখা দিয়েছে। এই ফুটবলারের বোন এলমা আভেইরো এক মন্তব্যে তাঁর ভাইয়ের দলে ফেরার সম্ভাবনা নিয়ে সন্দেহ প্রকাশ করেছেন।

item.title: Vigilance probe begins into Kochi apartment project irregularities
item.description: Authorities from the Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau have initiated an investigation into the Mundamveli P&T apartment project. Officials inspected the site and spoke with residents following claims of mismanagement.

item.title: দান-সদকায় ব্যক্তিগত সম্পদের ব্যবহারের সীমা

item.title: কক্সবাজার সরকারি কলেজ বন্ধুসভার সাংগঠনিক সভা অনুষ্ঠিত

item.description: মনোরোগ বিশেষজ্ঞরা মানসিক অবসাদ ও বিষণ্নতা কাটিয়ে ওঠার জন্য নির্দিষ্ট কিছু পন্থার কথা উল্লেখ করেছেন। এই উপায়গুলো অনুসরণ করলে ব্যক্তিজীবনে আনন্দ ও মানসিক শান্তি ফিরিয়ে আনা সম্ভব।

item.description: সিভিল সার্ভিস প্রিলিমিনারি পরীক্ষা উপযুক্ত প্রতিভা বাছাইয়ের ক্ষেত্রে কতটা কার্যকর তা নিয়ে প্রশ্ন উঠেছে। পরীক্ষার গঠন ও ন্যায্যতা নিয়ে পর্যালোচনার প্রয়োজন রয়েছে বলে মনে করছেন সংশ্লিষ্টরা।

item.title: Tamil Nadu evaluates Karnataka school fault tracking app
item.description: Tamil Nadu is interested in adopting the Namma Shale application. The platform previously identified building defects, sanitation issues, and water shortages in over 1,300 Karnataka public schools.

item.title: New community library opens in Bengaluru
item.description: A local educator has established a fresh reading space in Bengaluru. The founder shared her motivations, details about the inventory, and her vision for the initiative.

item.title: Four fatalities reported in severe Indonesian blazes
item.description: Indonesia has confirmed four deaths amidst its most severe wildfires in over ten years. Authorities in Jakarta have announced they will now accept international assistance to control the disaster.

item.title: Michigan child saves grandmother by seeking help
item.description: A five-year-old boy in Michigan rescued his grandmother during a medical crisis. He and his younger sister left the home to find assistance after discovering her unresponsive.

item.title: UK resident turns £20 comic purchase into £63,440
item.description: A British buyer who spent £20 on a box of vintage comics at a market discovered rare Superman editions. The valuable books were later auctioned for £63,440 following online verification.

item.title: Multi-vehicle crash on Hyderabad expressway
item.description: An electric vehicle collided with a median divider on the PVNR Expressway in Hyderabad, causing a chain reaction involving several other automobiles.

item.title: Benchmark notes decline in anti-rival funding norms
item.description: Venture firm Benchmark acknowledges that Silicon Valley's traditional policy against investing in competing companies is becoming increasingly difficult to uphold.

item.title: TPCC leader urges BC and OBC census category
item.description: The head of the TPCC renewed calls for a dedicated BC and OBC section in the upcoming 2027 Census. He also pledged increased political representation for these communities.

item.title: Grounded Kuwait Airways Plane Departs Thiruvananthapuram
item.description: A Kuwait Airways flight that was delayed in Thiruvananthapuram due to suspected bird-hit damage and subsequent technical problems has flown back to Kuwait.

item.title: Congress attempted to turn Supreme Court premises into protest site: BJP
item.description: As reported by The Hindu, The party accuses Rahul Gandhi and his allies of using “mob pressure to intimidate the judiciary”. Key points: Congress, Supreme Court, Rahul Gandhi, congress.

item.title: Record Vessel Attacks Recorded Near Hormuz Strait
item.description: Data analyzed by BBC Verify from a British maritime organization indicates that a record 12 ships were targeted in the vicinity over a single week, coinciding with declining oil shipments.

item.title: Pakistani Parliament Approves KP Emergency and Rule
item.description: Lawmakers endorsed the federal administration's October 11 declaration of emergency and governor's rule in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, pointing to local inaction against militants amid increasing violence.

item.title: Geopolitical Impact of Elon Musk's Starlink Network
item.description: Originally built for isolated areas, Starlink now plays a crucial role in conflict zones and crisis areas. However, Ukraine's experience highlights the vulnerabilities of relying heavily on this technology.

item.description: মাদারীপুরের শিবচরে নামাজ শেষ করে রাস্তা পার হওয়ার সময় মোটরসাইকেলের ধাক্কায় শহিদুল ইসলাম নামের স্থানীয় এক বিএনপি নেতা নিহত হয়েছেন।

item.title: Two Die in Separate Drowning Incidents in Andhra
item.description: A 70-year-old cattle farmer was swept away in Madhyalanka, while a 25-year-old perished when his fishing boat overturned. The second victim's parents managed to swim ashore.

item.title: Kerala Rubber Sector Revives Amid High Market Prices
item.description: Higher market rates and strong demand from tire makers are boosting Kerala's plantation industry. This renewed momentum has increased interest in leasing land and share-tapping agreements.

item.title: ঢাকায় দুই দিনের উচ্চশিক্ষা মেলা শুরু

item.title: Strong 6.9 magnitude earthquake strikes off Russian coast
item.description: A seismic event initially measured at 6.5 was later upgraded to 6.9 by scientists near Ozernovskiy, Russia. The Geological Survey reported that the tremor registered as a magnitude-5 intensity in the area.

item.title: Luxury tour packages offer VIP access to Kolkata Durga Puja
item.description: Curated tours for the 2026 festival will feature private convoys, Ganga river cruises, and local food tastings. These experiences aim to help visitors bypass long lines and explore the city's culture.

item.title: Sri Lanka approved for $345 million IMF fund disbursement
item.description: The International Monetary Fund has unlocked funds for Sri Lanka while cautioning that regional conflicts, climate shifts, and rising energy costs pose risks to ongoing financial recovery.

item.title: Missile strike on Aden presidential palace leaves five dead
item.description: A Thursday Houthi missile attack targeted command facilities at the presidential palace in Aden, killing five people and injuring 16. Saudi Arabia subsequently accused Iran of escalating the protracted conflict.

item.title: India features nearly kilometer-long wildlife overpass
item.description: An infrastructure bridge nearly a kilometer in length spans a railway yard, highway, and golf course to assist local fauna. Observers note that heavily trafficked roads require similar passages for animals.

item.title: Sudha Yadav takes oath as new Governor of Karnataka
item.description: The former parliamentarian and Kargil conflict widow has replaced Thaawarchand Gehlot in the role. She becomes the second female official to serve in this gubernatorial position.

item.title: Bystander fatally shoots suspect at Oregon elementary school
item.description: A shooting incident at Silver Rail Elementary School in Bend, Oregon, resulted in the deaths of three minors and one educator. An armed bystander subsequently killed the suspected gunman.

item.title: Rajnath Singh claims Congress aims for violent regime change
item.description: Amid demonstrations against the Chief Election Commissioner, Rajnath Singh asserted that Congress demonstrations target independent institutions rather than voter lists.

item.title: Shivraj Chouhan meets CM Mohan Yadav over Kosmi demolition dispute
item.description: Union Minister Shivraj Chouhan headed a group to discuss the Kosmi demolition action with Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav. The talks came amid rumors of internal party tension caused by the local administration and forest department razing structures.

item.title: সৌদি আরবগামী যাত্রীরা ভিন্ন পথ ব্যবহার করছেন
item.description: সৌদি আরব যাওয়ার উদ্দেশ্যে প্রস্থানকারী যাত্রীরা বর্তমানে নির্ধারিত পথের পরিবর্তে বিকল্প রুট ব্যবহার করছেন। এই পরিবর্তন সংক্রান্ত বিস্তারিত তথ্য সংশ্লিষ্ট মাধ্যম থেকে জানা গেছে।

item.title: Mexican 75-year-old chef outpaces Martha Stewart on YouTube
item.description: Seventy-five-year-old Doña Ángela Garfias Vázquez has drawn massive viewership on her rural Michoacán cooking channel, surpassing Martha Stewart. Her online videos highlight traditional recipes, local ingredients, and classic preparation techniques.

item.description: As reported by Hindustan Times, Munitions India Limited is set to face a clean. Key points: Ammo, Munitions India Limited, clean, graft.

item.description: A 237-year-old family celebration in Behala maintains East Bengal culinary traditions. The Bandyopadhyay household presents hilsa fish to the deity during Navami alongside heirloom recipes and traditional jewelry.

item.title: Churches in Chhattisgarh Post Warning Signs After New Law
item.description: Christian institutions in Dhamtari have erected caution notices for non-believers. Officials state these measures prevent legal repercussions under the state's recently enacted religious freedom legislation.

item.title: ইয়েমেনে প্রাসাদে হামলা, নিহত ৫ ও আহত ১৬
item.description: ইয়েমেনের একটি রাষ্ট্রীয় প্রাসাদে ক্ষেপণাস্ত্র আঘাত হেনেছে। এই হামলায় পাঁচজন নিহত এবং ষোলোজন আহত হয়েছেন বলে একজন সরকারি মন্ত্রী নিশ্চিত করেছেন।

item.title: Rupee gains 20 paise against US dollar as RBI support kicks in, greenback weakens
item.description: As reported by Times of India, On Friday, the Rupee showcased a solid performance, climbing 20 paise to affected 94.79 against the US dollar, building on gains from the previous day helped by a softer dollar and actions by the Reserve Bank of India. Key points: Rupee, On Friday, Reserve Bank, India.

item.description: As reported by Times of India, Wasim Jaffer raised eyebrows over Rinku Singh not making the cut for India's T20I lineup, insisting that Rinku's presence might have shifted the tide in the fourth match against the West Indies. Key points: India, Gambhir, Wasim Jaffer, Rinku Singh.

item.title: Marseille falls to Olympiakos in Europa League
item.description: Marseille recorded a second straight Europa League defeat after a 1-0 loss to Olympiakos. In contrast, Lyon earned a victory against English club Crystal Palace.

item.title: Production changes hit The Royals season two
item.description: Season two of The Royals experienced creative changes as director Jasmeet K Reen left the project and Bhumi Pednekar departed. Filming resumed in Jaipur under Mitakshara Kumar, with previous footage slated for reshooting.

item.title: Man killed in Satkhira following Facebook Live
item.description: Thirty-eight-year-old Wahiduzzaman Shamim was beaten to death in Satkhira's Debhata after a crowd gathered following allegations broadcast on Facebook Live. Police rescued him initially, but he was attacked again at a hospital.
